The Registered Nurse Out-Patient Wound Care is a clinical nurse who assesses, treats, educates, and manages patients with complicated wounds related to trauma, surgical procedures, pressure injuries, and diabetic and vascular ulcer, as well as patients requiring ostomy care (including colostomy, ileostomy, and urostomy management). They utilize a variety of dressings, pouching systems, and advanced treatment modalities while considering comorbidities, psychosocial influences, and patient goals and abilities. They collaborate closely with members of the patient care team to ensure efficacy of treatment, optimization of resources, and support for patient self-management and quality of life.
